src: full-width colored bars with aligned three-column comb motifs; the final full-width bar is the separator color
dst: compact rows in the same top-to-bottom bar order
transform: paint each row with the bar color repeated once per solid motif row, append the separator color column, and place the singleton control pixel on the row whose open motif center is nearest to it
multi_step: top-to-bottom order breaks equal marker-center distances
grid_shape: one row per non-separator bar; columns are count slots plus separator and control-pixel columns
